##Two-Space Low Pincer
Popular in the 17th century, this pincer is still played in contemporary games. Contrary to its former "leisurely" reputation (according to Hideo Otake and others), this move can spark fighting after White <A:Q15> (see <Position:26800>). AI analysis scores the fight as relatively equal, diverging from traditional expectations. If White opts out of the fight, the game might continue with simple moves.

See [Michael Redmond, *AlphaGo vs. The World: Game 34, Dang Yifei 9p (W) vs. AlphaGo Master (B)*](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jL7D9U6d7W4&t=80s).

[Explanation by Go Inside on Youtube (SDK/Dan)](https://youtu.be/qlYiRBuwzKE?si=gW8cV9B2aLuLsFSt)
